format: nine contracts and a separate finale
authority: Original game campaign proposals grounded in the supplied books; not additional published Mecha Hack canon

sources.use: Lodestar history, faction identities, named leaders and locations
Setting, campaign combinations, mission hooks, obstacles and consequences

guardrails: All player action stays inside mecha; boarding uses mecha-sized hangars and service galleries.
The Voidmaw are a devouring threat, never a contracting employer.
Slipstar has no Verilian Tunnels; transit there uses ships, docks and surface routes.
The One-Mind remains unidentified; no branch declares a canonical answer.
New contacts, operations and local outcomes are original game material. Published leaders are neither killed nor replaced.

campaigns.title: The Workers' Signal
campaigns.premise: A repair-yard distress call exposes a struggle over who owns the infrastructure that keeps a liberated district alive.
campaigns.question: Who gets to decide what liberation costs?
campaigns.setting: Terran districts on Aeon Prime; later operations use nearby orbital depots.

threads.label: Keep People Supplied
threads.intent: Protect the district before buying another offensive.
threads.established: Local crews can sustain the evacuation corridors.
threads.neglected: Shelters depend on a single exposed supply route.
threads.tradeoff: Other districts wait while this route is protected.

threads.label: Publish the Ledger
threads.intent: Recover proof and let the districts judge their patrons.
threads.established: Independent relays can distribute the recovered records.
threads.neglected: Claims about ownership remain easy to deny.
threads.tradeoff: The occupation keeps working machinery while copies are secured.

threads.label: Seize the Machinery
threads.intent: Turn the occupiers' production chain against them.
threads.established: Captured yards can support a disciplined counterstroke.
threads.neglected: The district faces an intact enemy production line.
threads.tradeoff: A stronger patron gains a claim on the yards.

cast.name: Dara Ven
cast.want: Keep the repair crews fed and self-governing.
cast.contradiction: Will accept a royal escort but refuses its permanent garrison.
cast.voice: Concrete costs; names every crew before every machine.

cast.name: Oren Sile
cast.want: Secure an enforceable local ceasefire.
cast.contradiction: Treats protection as a debt while sincerely protecting workers.
cast.voice: Formal promises followed by exact conditions.

cast.name: Vesk Ara
cast.want: Keep the requisition network functioning.
cast.contradiction: Offers lawful rations while treating labor as another component.
cast.voice: Administrative precision; no invented One-Mind revelations.

beats.title: The Yard Calls Back
beats.situation: A yard broadcasts on an abandoned maintenance frequency.
beats.clue: A requisition order values working reactors above their crews.

offers.title: Bring the Yard Home
offers.briefing: Dara needs the training convoy brought through the scrap lanes.
offers.result: The district gains a reliable transport crew.

offers.title: Read the Wreck Tags
offers.briefing: Recover the yard cores before their ownership records are wiped.
offers.result: Recovered tags expose the first requisition link.

offers.title: Break the Yard Lock
offers.briefing: Clear the machines enforcing the yard lockdown.
offers.result: The occupation loses its nearest collection point.

beats.question: What must the first independent repair yard keep: its convoy, its records, or control of its gates?

beats.title: Fuel Is a Vote
beats.situation: A biofuel station becomes the price of a new local alliance.
beats.clue: The same shipment has been promised to two garrisons.

offers.title: Last Bus from Kuro
offers.briefing: Escort the evacuation convoy; its fuel reserve cannot cover a second run.
offers.result: Civilian crews begin sharing safe routes.

offers.title: Keep the Pump Speaking
offers.briefing: Hold the station while its operators transmit their delivery records.
offers.result: The fuel ledger acquires independent witnesses.

offers.title: No More Collections
offers.briefing: Stop the force advancing on the captured requisition officer.
offers.result: The district keeps a bargaining piece out of enemy hands.

beats.question: Will Kuro's fuel protect evacuees, public testimony, or a bargaining position?

beats.title: A Name on Every Crate
beats.situation: A runaway freight line carries both stolen machinery and trapped crews.
beats.clue: Freight seals point to a supposedly neutral broker.

offers.title: Crew Before Cargo
offers.briefing: Recover the escape capsules scattered along the freight route.
offers.result: Repair crews return to work on their own terms.

offers.title: A Train with Witnesses
offers.briefing: Escort the intercepted transport to a siding where its records can be checked.
offers.result: The intact manifests connect the broker to the occupation.

offers.title: Cut the Collection Line
offers.briefing: Destroy the power relays feeding the runaway freight route.
offers.result: The collection network loses a major artery.

beats.question: Which part of the freight seizure can the district afford to lose?

beats.title: The Broker Denies Everything
beats.situation: A broker denies the reported cargo diversion and jettisons a new cargo trail rather than submit to inspection.
beats.clue: A ledger fragment also implicates one of the district's would-be allies.

offers.title: Recover the Ration Cases
offers.briefing: Secure the jettisoned cases and carry them back in your mecha.
offers.result: Dara can promise another week of supplies.

offers.title: Scan the Flight Plan
offers.briefing: Scan the fallen cargo for its navigation records.
offers.result: The inquiry reaches beyond a single occupation commander.

offers.title: Burn the Brokers Reserve
offers.briefing: Destroy the exposed ship stores before the broker retrieves them.
offers.result: The broker loses the means to finance an immediate reprisal.

beats.question: Can the broker keep selling the same cargo once the squad chooses what to preserve?

beats.title: Whose Banner Covers Us
beats.situation: A Neo envoy offers the district protection with a clause nobody announced over the radio.
beats.clue: Protection would transfer control of district power distribution.

offers.title: Keep the Freighter Free
offers.briefing: Escort the captured freighter past the royal cordon.
offers.result: The district retains an independent supply route.

offers.title: A Witness under Armor
offers.briefing: Disable the royal command machine and recover its controller intact.
offers.result: The protection clause can be challenged with direct testimony.

offers.title: Hold the Rally Ground
offers.briefing: Reach the resistance rally and prevent its dispersal.
offers.result: The district enters negotiations with a defensible position.

beats.question: Will the district's protection agreement preserve its independence or replace one owner with another?
beats.opponent_role: a Neo cordon whose protection terms the district contests

beats.title: The Price of Working Power
beats.situation: Overloaded generators threaten the very yards the squad has secured.
beats.clue: The overload is consistent with deliberate remote requisition.

offers.title: Keep the Coolant Moving
offers.briefing: Hold the cooling installation through the shutdown.
offers.result: The district keeps usable power instead of a victory crater.

offers.title: People Carry the Evidence
offers.briefing: Recover personnel capsules from the reactor exclusion zone.
offers.result: Operators can explain the remote override sequence.

offers.title: Deny the Overload
offers.briefing: Destroy unstable reactor stores before they breach.
offers.result: The occupation cannot trigger a larger industrial collapse.

beats.question: What survives an industrial emergency when preserving the plant, the operators and containment require different operations?

beats.title: The Line Answers Back
beats.situation: Other crews now use the first distress frequency to request support.
beats.clue: The requests are coordinated, but not by a single new leader.

offers.title: Hold the Workers Rally
offers.briefing: Reach the labor force and defend its rallying point.
offers.result: Separate crews begin supporting one another.

offers.title: The Relay Must Last
offers.briefing: Occupy the communications array while the districts compare demands.
offers.result: The councils hear one another without an official intermediary.

offers.title: Take the Enforcer Intact
offers.briefing: Disable the enforcer commander and recover its pilot.
offers.result: The uprising gains leverage before the next assault.

beats.question: Will the uprising gain mutual support, a common voice, or a captured enforcer?

beats.title: The Occupier Wants a Symbol
beats.situation: A strike on a shelter uplink could turn the entire campaign into a warning.
beats.clue: The target is the district assembly record, not a weapons cache.

offers.title: Bring the Shelter Home
offers.briefing: Recover the shelter capsule before the next strike.
offers.result: The district keeps its evacuation organizers.

offers.title: Save the Prototype Record
offers.briefing: Recover the prototype carrying the assembly transmission log.
offers.result: The district retains a record no single patron can edit.

offers.title: Keep the Uplink Alive
offers.briefing: Protect the transmission mast through the emergency broadcast.
offers.result: The enemy fails to impose a single account of the uprising.

beats.question: Can the district protect its people and its public account before the next strike?

beats.title: Before the Yard Gates Open
beats.situation: The occupation prepares one last machine to retake the repair district.
beats.clue: Its assembly schedule confirms that the final assault is imminent.

offers.title: Keep Something Worth Repairing
offers.briefing: Recover the surviving machine instead of leaving only molten scrap.
offers.result: The district can repair what it has won.

offers.title: Clear the Rival Salvagers
offers.briefing: Remove the rival force attempting to seize the assembly records.
offers.result: The evidence remains outside the returning occupiers' control.

offers.title: Stop the Last Assembly
offers.briefing: Destroy the assembly stores feeding the final counterattack.
offers.result: The final enemy enters battle without its industrial reserve.

beats.question: What reserve should the district carry into the occupiers' final counterattack?

finales.title: A District That Can Breathe
finales.setup: The final assault threatens the corridors your contracts kept open.
finales.payoff: The surviving network distributes power locally; Dara refuses to trade it for a new uniform.
finales.continuation: The district crews receive a supply appeal from Slipstar, where a blockade is turning life support into leverage.

finales.title: The Ledger Goes Public
finales.setup: A protected uplink must outlast the force sent to suppress the evidence.
finales.payoff: The records reach separate district councils. They agree on the theft, not on who should govern next.
finales.continuation: The disputed signatures point to damaged Aeonic records that no surviving district ledger can explain.

finales.title: The Keys to the Foundry
finales.setup: The enemy field commander makes a final attempt to retake the yards.
finales.payoff: The yards remain in allied hands. Oren presents the cost of maintaining his protection.
finales.continuation: The next protection claim arrives under a remnant standard, backed by an oath with competing interpretations.

canon_anchors: The Terran Collective is a workers resistance united by Thea Node; Dara Ven is an original local contact, not her replacement.
Aeon Prime is occupied former Dominion territory; this story concerns one repair district, not the liberation of the entire world.

campaigns.title: Crown and Circuit
campaigns.premise: A remnant knightly command asks the squad to recover symbols of legitimacy that are also working pieces of a defense network.
campaigns.question: Does an oath protect people or the right to command them?
campaigns.setting: Fortress Husqvarna and occupied former Dominion territory.

threads.label: Keep the Oath
threads.intent: Protect the people named in the oath, even when orders disagree.
threads.established: Refugees and knightly escorts can organize their own withdrawal.
threads.neglected: Royal protection depends on an increasingly narrow cordon.
threads.tradeoff: The command reserve waits while evacuees receive protection.

threads.label: Test the Claim
threads.intent: Recover evidence before accepting a claim of rightful command.
threads.established: Independent testimony constrains the next command council.
threads.neglected: Ceremonial claims outrun the available evidence.
threads.tradeoff: Military readiness receives less attention than testimony.

threads.label: Restore the Standard
threads.intent: Secure strategic assets for a disciplined remnant command.
threads.established: The remnant can mount a coordinated counterattack.
threads.neglected: The remaining knights lack a common operational reserve.
threads.tradeoff: A stronger command reserve can deepen dependence on its officers.

cast.name: Maelin Rook
cast.want: Fulfil a defensive oath without sacrificing its dependents.
cast.contradiction: Will disobey an order but will not casually renounce the dynasty.
cast.voice: Precise vows; anger appears as increasingly short sentences.

cast.name: Sena Marr
cast.want: Keep refugees from becoming collateral in a restoration.
cast.contradiction: Needs knightly transport she does not trust politically.
cast.voice: Direct questions about who is actually aboard.

cast.name: Cairn Vell
cast.want: Preserve a usable chain of command.
cast.contradiction: Confuses institutional survival with public consent.
cast.voice: Polished ceremony over practical urgency.

beats.title: The Trial Has a Witness
beats.situation: A routine trial becomes a test of who receives protection.
beats.clue: The exercise roster omits the support crews.

offers.title: Guard the Other Trainee
offers.briefing: Reach the allied trainee and hold the rally point.
offers.result: Maelin sees the squad honor a practical oath.

offers.title: Mark the Tournament Ground
offers.briefing: Hold the tournament marker while the exercise record is preserved.
offers.result: Sena gains a verifiable record of the trial.

offers.title: Take the Champion Intact
offers.briefing: Disable the rival machine without destroying its cockpit.
offers.result: Cairn gains a champion who can still answer orders.

beats.question: What does the trial reward: protecting a trainee, preserving a public marker, or taking the champion intact?

beats.title: A Passage for the Unsworn
beats.situation: A cordon separates refugee transports from a knightly escort.
beats.clue: The cordon recognizes insignia before distress calls.

offers.title: Map the Safe Gap
offers.briefing: Survey the radar network before the next refugee run.
offers.result: The convoy gains a route outside the insignia system.

offers.title: Take the Cordon Voice
offers.briefing: Disable the blockade commander for recovery.
offers.result: The cordon orders can be questioned directly.

offers.title: Silence the Battery Stores
offers.briefing: Destroy the artillery stores maintaining the cordon.
offers.result: The remnant gains room to assemble its fleet.

beats.question: Which part of the blockade must yield before people without insignia can pass?

beats.title: What the Wreck Remembers
beats.situation: A crashed retreat transport leaves survivors and a city rally point under threat.
beats.clue: Its command record conflicts with the public account of the retreat.

offers.title: Recover the Retreat Survivors
offers.briefing: Extract survivor capsules from the crashed transport.
offers.result: Transport crews can still guide the next evacuation.

offers.title: Recover the Command Witness
offers.briefing: Disable the hostile commander and recover its pilot.
offers.result: The retreat account gains a witness who can answer for the orders.

offers.title: Hold the City Rally
offers.briefing: Reach the city garrison and hold its central rally point.
offers.result: The remnant retains a staging position for its next defense.

beats.question: Which part of the failed retreat can the remnant reclaim: its survivors, the command witness, or the city rally?

beats.title: Two Versions of Valor
beats.situation: A rival knight challenges the squad over the contested retreat record.
beats.clue: The rival obeyed an order intended to be secret.

offers.title: Stand Beside the Rival
offers.briefing: Reach the rival and hold a joint defensive position.
offers.result: The oath becomes a shared duty instead of a duel.

offers.title: Keep the Duel Broadcasting
offers.briefing: Hold the rival occupied while the record is transmitted.
offers.result: The dispute can no longer be confined to officers.

offers.title: Take the Challenge
offers.briefing: Disable the rival without destroying its cockpit.
offers.result: Cairn keeps the command dispute within knightly procedure.

beats.question: Can the rival be confronted without making another enemy of someone bound by the same oath?
beats.opponent_role: a rival remnant detachment contesting the retreat record

beats.title: A Throne Is Not a Fuel Pump
beats.situation: A station commander demands allegiance in exchange for evacuation fuel.
beats.clue: The fuel was already paid for by the departing communities.

offers.title: Escort the Paying Passengers
offers.briefing: Bring the civilian convoy through the station cordon.
offers.result: The refugees retain their right to the purchased fuel.

offers.title: Hold the Accounts Office
offers.briefing: Protect the installation while its delivery accounts are copied.
offers.result: The station bargain can be challenged in public.

offers.title: Keep the Officer Secure
offers.briefing: Prevent the enemy reaching the captured officer.
offers.result: The remnant retains leverage over the fuel route.

beats.question: Does the fuel station owe its first duty to the people who paid or to the commander who controls it?
beats.opponent_role: the station commander's local remnant detachment

beats.title: The Ship with No Audience
beats.situation: A warship offers a mobile command post and room for thousands of evacuees.
beats.clue: The cargo allocation leaves little space for passengers.

offers.title: Cover the Passenger Route
offers.briefing: Escort the escape transport through the contested shipyard.
offers.result: The departing convoy retains a route out.

offers.title: Recover the Restrained Witness
offers.briefing: Recover the restrained prisoner capsule from the hull.
offers.result: Sena gains a witness outside the command circle.

offers.title: Keep the Ronin Powered
offers.briefing: Protect the ship power core through capture.
offers.result: The remnant gains a functioning staging vessel.

beats.question: Will the Ronin become a passenger route, a source of testimony, or a functioning command ship?

beats.title: The Standard in the Snow
beats.situation: A frozen station shelters technicians who can restore the defense network.
beats.clue: Their work contracts include compulsory military service.

offers.title: Bring the Technicians Through
offers.briefing: Escort the scientists through the frozen industrial zone.
offers.result: The technicians reach safety with witnesses.

offers.title: Recover the Work Contracts
offers.briefing: Recover the evidence caches before their destruction.
offers.result: The compulsory service clause becomes a live dispute.

offers.title: Remove the Explosive Reserve
offers.briefing: Destroy the stores threatening the frozen station.
offers.result: The remnant gains usable infrastructure instead of an icebound grave.

beats.question: What must be secured before the frozen stations compulsory service clause can be challenged?

beats.title: The Wrong Order Arrives
beats.situation: A sealed order demands a withdrawal that would abandon the next convoy.
beats.clue: Its authentication is valid; its judgment is still contestable.

offers.title: Escort the Unscheduled Freighter
offers.briefing: Bring the captured freighter out of the contested territory.
offers.result: Maelin acts on the protective part of the oath.

offers.title: Recover the Orders Controller
offers.briefing: Disable the command machine and retrieve its controller.
offers.result: The disputed order can be examined without guessing its author.

offers.title: Hold the Remnant Rally
offers.briefing: Reach the rally point and keep the formation intact.
offers.result: Cairn can present a coherent defense to the next assault.

beats.question: Which duty takes precedence when an authenticated withdrawal order abandons a convoy?
beats.opponent_role: the command detachment enforcing the disputed withdrawal

beats.title: What the Shield Covers
beats.situation: The enemy prepares to force a choice between fleet cohesion and embarkation.
beats.clue: The final attack will follow the least protected corridor.

offers.title: Carry the Delegates Clear
offers.briefing: Escort the faction delegates out of the battle zone.
offers.result: The evacuation compact remains possible.

offers.title: Survey the Converging Front
offers.briefing: Scan the warship power network from your mecha.
offers.result: The remnant enters the final operation with verified positions.

offers.title: Recover the Diplomatic Reserve
offers.briefing: Recover the diplomatic archive capsules from the converging battle.
offers.result: The remnant retains leverage for its final defensive agreement.

beats.question: What can the squad preserve for the last defense without assuming that military authority is public consent?

finales.title: The Oath Has Passengers
finales.setup: The final force approaches the embarkation corridors.
finales.payoff: Maelin keeps the evacuation compact. No victory here grants the squad the throne of Lodestar.
finales.continuation: The protected refugee convoy needs supplies at Slipstar, where the next safe berth lies behind a blockade.

finales.title: A Claim with Witnesses
finales.setup: The final enemy tries to destroy the records before judgment.
finales.payoff: The surviving witnesses force a public dispute over command; Ilyn Acharis remains the exiled prince.
finales.continuation: The remnant hearing requires a missing Aeonic record whose surviving copies disagree.

finales.title: A Standard Still Flying
finales.setup: The last assault concentrates against the restored defensive network.
finales.payoff: The knights retain a defensible position, but the demands of those they protected remain.
finales.continuation: A distant fortress requests a mobile command ship, and the only available hull has competing owners.

canon_anchors: The Neo Dominion remains loyal to the exiled Prince Ilyn Acharis and House Acharis.
Fortress Husqvarna is the prince's floating stronghold, protected by adapted Aeonic shield technology; local officers do not inherit the throne through these contracts.

campaigns.title: The Third Arrival
campaigns.premise: A damaged Aeonic relay contains contradictory accounts of the delayed colony ship, and every faction wants to control the survivors' account.
campaigns.question: Can a history be recovered without becoming another instrument of conquest?
campaigns.setting: Aeon Prime, relay stations and mecha-sized wreck interiors.

threads.label: Shelter the Disconnected
threads.intent: Protect people who can no longer rely on their old command links.
threads.established: Disconnected crews can maintain their own safe channels.
threads.neglected: Isolated crews remain dependent on a commanding patron.
threads.tradeoff: Some damaged records stay exposed while crews are moved.

threads.label: Keep the Contradictions
threads.intent: Preserve incompatible records until they can be examined together.
threads.established: Independent copies make a single official history harder to impose.
threads.neglected: The surviving records can still be selectively edited.
threads.tradeoff: The command route receives less protection while copies are secured.

threads.label: Control the Relays
threads.intent: Secure the machinery that decides whose orders arrive.
threads.established: A controlled relay chain can sustain the final deployment.
threads.neglected: A rival can still sever the fleet by taking one relay.
threads.tradeoff: A functional relay can preserve the custody the crews distrust.

cast.name: Ilex Seven
cast.want: Recover the voices of a disconnected crew.
cast.contradiction: Defends their humanity while accepting much of Aeonic command practice.
cast.voice: Precise collective terms, then an unexpectedly personal correction.

cast.name: Mina Tal
cast.want: Preserve testimony without handing a fresh weapon to the invaders.
cast.contradiction: Will shelter an Aeon but will not excuse the occupation.
cast.voice: Names sources and separates observation from inference.

cast.name: Seret Ka
cast.want: Restore a relay chain before hostile forces exploit it.
cast.contradiction: Regards contradictory records as a military vulnerability.
cast.voice: Short diagnostic phrases and exact limits.

beats.title: An Order without a Sender
beats.situation: An exercise relay issues a second incompatible command.
beats.clue: Neither command reveals who or what the One-Mind is.

offers.title: Keep the Training Relay
offers.briefing: Protect the exercise uplink until the disconnected crews clear it.
offers.result: The crews retain a route out of the test zone.

offers.title: Trace the Duplicate Order
offers.briefing: Scan the course markers for the second command sequence.
offers.result: Mina receives two independently recorded orders.

offers.title: Secure the Relay Ace
offers.briefing: Disable the academy ace and recover its command controller.
offers.result: Seret gains a working command interface.

beats.question: What should survive two incompatible orders: the disconnected crews, both readings, or the command interface?

beats.title: A Survivor Is Not a Specimen
beats.situation: A missing experimental pilot has become valuable to competing collectors.
beats.clue: The pilot can identify a relay route, not the origin of Aeonic authority.

offers.title: Recover the Missing Pilot
offers.briefing: Recover the pilot's sealed capsule from the utility district.
offers.result: A living witness reaches the disconnected crews.

offers.title: Clear the Witness Route
offers.briefing: Remove the machines preventing access to the witness district.
offers.result: Independent recovery teams can examine the site.

offers.title: Break the Collector Network
offers.briefing: Destroy the command stores supplying the collectors.
offers.result: The rival collection chain loses its local base.

beats.question: Can the experimental pilot be recovered without treating a person as another research specimen?

beats.title: What the Eclipse Kept
beats.situation: A wreck contains barrier keys alongside records of a broken retreat.
beats.clue: The keys can verify access but cannot authenticate the oldest logs.

offers.title: Bring the Transport Clear
offers.briefing: Escort the survivor transport away from the wreck.
offers.result: The crews keep their evacuation team.

offers.title: Read the Barrier Memory
offers.briefing: Scan the barrier controllers for access history.
offers.result: The archive gains a record from a different system.

offers.title: Recover the Wreck Weapon
offers.briefing: Recover the capital-ship salvage before rival crews seize it.
offers.result: Seret secures leverage for the next relay passage.

beats.question: Which part of the Eclipse will let a disputed account survive its next owner?

beats.title: The Cold Archive
beats.situation: Researchers at a frozen station disagree about the records they have preserved.
beats.clue: Their disagreement predates the current relay damage.

offers.title: Escort the Researchers
offers.briefing: Bring the scientists through the frozen industrial zone.
offers.result: The argument survives with its participants.

offers.title: Recover Both Accounts
offers.briefing: Recover the evidence caches before either is destroyed.
offers.result: Contradictory records remain available for comparison.

offers.title: Deny the Station Demolition
offers.briefing: Destroy the stores that could erase the entire station.
offers.result: The relay campaign retains a usable staging post.

beats.question: Will the frozen archive keep its disputing researchers, their incompatible records, or its usable infrastructure?

beats.title: The Hub Offers Certainty
beats.situation: A network hub offers to reconcile the conflicting reports now reaching the disconnected crews.
beats.clue: The reconciliation would overwrite records that fail its checks.

offers.title: Take the Interceptor Alive
offers.briefing: Disable the interceptor and retrieve its pilot before the upload.
offers.result: The crews gain someone who can question the overwrite order.

offers.title: Copy before Consensus
offers.briefing: Download the relay data with the mecha scanner.
offers.result: The unmerged accounts survive outside the hub.

offers.title: Cut the Overwrite Power
offers.briefing: Destroy the exposed hub power centers.
offers.result: The overwrite stops, at the price of a damaged command route.

beats.question: Who gets to decide which observations the hub's reconciliation is allowed to erase?
beats.opponent_role: a relay custody detachment enforcing the overwrite

beats.title: The Price of a Clean Signal
beats.situation: Nanotech cleanup routines spread into occupied industrial districts.
beats.clue: Their control signature resembles the relay correction process.

offers.title: Retrieve the Sealed Pods
offers.briefing: Recover survivors from the factory evacuation pods.
offers.result: More crews can testify to what the cleanup changed.

offers.title: Trace the Factory Pattern
offers.briefing: Survey the outbreak sites using sealed onboard instruments.
offers.result: The archive gains a reproducible technical comparison.

offers.title: Reach the Restart Unit
offers.briefing: Secure the factory control unit through its restart.
offers.result: A working installation can support the isolated fleet.

beats.question: What can be preserved when the cleanup process spreads beyond the machines it was meant to repair?
beats.opponent_role: compromised cleanup machines at an Aeonic installation

beats.title: The Ronin Has Room
beats.situation: A prison ship could carry the disconnected crews beyond the contested relay net.
beats.clue: Its power controls also hold the prisoner's release record.

offers.title: Cover the Escape Transport
offers.briefing: Escort the escape transport through the shipyard.

campaigns.title: Beneath the Open War
campaigns.premise: Routine maintenance reveals a growing Voidmaw incursion beneath battlefields the human factions are too busy contesting to secure.
campaigns.question: What must be saved when every side calls its own front the only real war?
campaigns.setting: Aeon Prime service depths, quarantine districts and a remote frozen research site.

threads.label: Keep a Way Out
threads.intent: Secure shelters and extraction corridors before the next breach.
threads.established: Evacuation crews know several routes out of the threatened districts.
threads.neglected: The threatened districts depend on a shrinking corridor.
threads.tradeoff: Support sites may remain intact beyond the evacuation corridor.

threads.label: Read the Incursion
threads.intent: Preserve observations and warning networks instead of guessing at the hive.
threads.established: Independent sensors reveal the next concentration of kaiju.
threads.neglected: The approaching threat remains badly mapped.
threads.tradeoff: Some evacuation work waits for a clearer threat picture.

threads.label: Close the Feeding Line
threads.intent: Destroy the resources sustaining the expanding incursion.
threads.established: The enemy reaches the final battle without its nearest support sites.
threads.neglected: The final concentration still draws on intact feeding sites.
threads.tradeoff: Useful observations can be lost with the support sites.

cast.name: Bo Arness

cast.voice: Separates readings from explanations.

cast.contradiction: May abandon a position too soon to preserve a larger force.
cast.voice: Maps every promise onto a defensive line.

campaigns.question: Who controls scarcity once the blockade has been broken?
